text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the opening paragraph","quality":"focus","description":"The essay states a definite position early and keeps returning to the same main claim."},{"evidence":"repeated claims about crashes and safety","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay builds its position with several linked reasons instead of mainly asking questions."},{"evidence":"\"What happens when there is such a big issue\" and \"the system glitches\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay expands its points with hypothetical consequences that make the argument more fully explained."},{"evidence":"\"car accidents are one of the leading causes\" and \"death and economic issues\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay connects the issue to broader harms, showing more cause-and-effect thinking."},{"evidence":"\"stick to manual cars and invest time in learning how to drive safely\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a clearer recommendation that summarizes its stance."}]}
